name: PDFMonkey Free
free_limit: 20 PDF documents per month; unlimited templates; 1 team member; 30-second maximum generation time.
watch_out: Generated documents retained for 1 day. Free plan cannot load external images, fonts, CSS or JavaScript, or use PDF share links. Unused monthly documents do not roll over; requests stop at quota. New accounts initially receive a separate 30-day Pro trial. Commercial-use terms require review.
